dedupe_keys.name: reconstruction of a digital elevation model in a lab scale urban drainage facility applying lidar and sfm techniques

description: Regueiro Picallo, Manuel and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The study reconstructs roof and pavement elevations in an urban-drainage experimental module using Structure from Motion and LiDAR. Coverage is the digital geometry needed by detailed hydraulic numerical models. The source reports mean vertical error below 2 mm for both reconstructions, while distinguishing point-cloud/mesh acquisition and processing differences. An existing SATURNO facility dataset provides related drainage geometry, but exact coincidence of the measurement campaigns is unproven. This case represents the documented reconstruction and accuracy assessment, not a newly discovered terrain-data package. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
